answer: The karst schedule is applied in kernel and trellis shows each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 24% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4966 identities would post 4415 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
